description: Docks the ThunderAI chat page in a resizable panel on the right side of a Thunderbird main window.

functions.name: open
functions.description: Opens (or reuses) the side panel in the given window and loads the URL. Resolves to false when the window can't host a panel (e.g. compose or standalone message windows).

functions.name: close
functions.description: Closes the side panel in every window.
